annotations.title: Reply to a ticket or add a note

description: Add a message to a ticket as the key's agent. With is_note=true it is an internal agent note (not shown to the requester); with is_note=false it is a REPLY that the helpdesk emails to the requester — that cannot be unsent. Deskpro: POST /api/v2/tickets/{id}/messages.

format.description: Format of the body. Default text.

is_note.description: true = internal agent note; false = public reply to the requester.
